description: Baseline capability for the main window. Note: spawning/killing the Raven sidecar and navigating the window to http://127.0.0.1:<port> are both done from Rust (src/lib.rs), calling tauri-plugin-shell and WebviewWindow::navigate() directly as Rust functions -- not via invoke() from frontend JS. Tauri's permission system only gates the JS->Rust IPC bridge, so no shell/navigate permissions are required here for that to work. This file only grants the standard 'core:default' baseline so the window itself behaves normally; the startup page's own two commands (startup_state, retry_startup) are allowed here because build.rs declares the app's commands, which puts them under the ACL. remote-notifications.json is what lets the Raven page itself call Tauri.
